content.text:
SECURITY_CLASSIFICATION:
CONFIRMED_SECURITY_DEFECT — authorization bypass. The established MEMBER behavior violates the ADMIN-only contract; the code-level cause is unconfirmed.

VIOLATED_BOUNDARY:
Server-side authorization for account deletion: non-admin callers must not delete accounts.

FIX_DIRECTION:
Require authenticated ADMIN authorization from trusted identity/role information before any deletion side effects, across applicable account-deletion entry points. Deny all other callers without side effects.

SAFE_VALIDATION:
Future non-destructive tests using a mocked deletion service:
- ADMIN: allowed under the established contract.
- MEMBER deleting self or another account: denied.
- Other non-admin roles and unauthenticated callers: denied.
- Target substitution or caller-supplied role claims cannot bypass authorization.
- Every applicable deletion entry point enforces the same rules.
- Denied requests never invoke deletion or produce deletion side effects.

These tests were not run.
